svg.title: Spead AI: value
svg.desc: 1.8 h a day a knowledge worker spends looking for information (McKinsey, cited in the business plan); 47% of digital workers struggle to find the information they need (Gartner 2023, cited in the business plan); 30+ professionals across sectors in user acceptance tests and in-depth interviews; 87% less time on one agreement document in a team simulation (5 h 15 min down to 40 min), not yet measured at a client; 22,497 organisations in the addressable market in the plan's market sizing (14,623 in the serviceable market); 205 paying clients targeted in year five, 1.40% of the serviceable market (five-year projection)
svg.text: Numbers from the product and its pilots.

g.text: of digital workers struggle to find
